reference: Actual frozen original graph constructors and CPU execution; no Rust expected values.
contracts: Inputs preserve complete source byte strides and raw words; result shape, byte strides and every output/state byte captured.
Most cases use one native worker; defined dense controls use three native workers. Rust DAG execution remains one worker.
MSVC and GNU profiles both leave GGML_SIMD off for these recurrent kernels. GNU SSE2 row-math elsewhere is a separate source conditional.
SSM_CONV intentionally covers source one-worker flattened coefficient row addressing with padded coefficient metadata.
SSM_SCAN includes per-state and per-head decay, grouped heads, stored-state IDs, physical token/sequence gaps and reverse-ordered final state snapshots.
No undefined native input is executed in this corpus. Zero-token scan/recurrence, invalid IDs and snapshots exceeding token count are safe-side rejection tests.
NaN payload outcomes are compiler-profile observations, not a general floating-point language guarantee.
Frozen C reference build and capture generator are outside the Rust product.
